images.title: DualSense Edge wireless controller (PS5), front and back
images.author: unreal-ng
images.terms: vector drawing from measured dimensions; photos used as references only, nothing traced

references.what: size 160 x 66 x 106 mm, 325 g: the DualSense's shell (devices/playstation.py) with the Edge's parts
references.source: Sony DualSense Edge specifications (playstation.com, dualsense-edge-wireless-controller) and retail listings

references.what: front: the two-tone (white shell, black face and touchpad, black buttons and shoulders), the stick modules' rings, the Fn buttons under the sticks, standing out of the bottom edge
references.author: Sonson2
references.note: the Fn buttons measured to about 1 mm on the near-top photo scaled by the stick spacing

references.what: back: the two back buttons in their bays under the grips, the trigger stop sliders, the cable lock housing round the USB-C port
references.note: drawn as the pad turned over towards the viewer (triggers at the bottom), so the right hand's back button stays on the right; positions and shapes estimated to about 2 mm
